entities.summary: Naomi Chanda is a Zambian farmer and agriculture trainer based in Chinsali, northern Zambia. She works with the Campaign for Female Education (Camfed) to teach climate-smart agricultural techniques and supports girls' education and empowerment through her community initiatives. Naomi Chanda was a writers & intellectuals from Chinsali District (b. 2000, Chinsali District). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
